notes: The Grouchy Ladybug is structured around time (clocks appear on every spread showing the hour) and size comparison (animals get progressively bigger). 'Clock' and 'sun' are already in aac_extras and existing activity_images respectively — confirm reuse. 'Ladybug', 'aphid', 'leaf', and 'whale' are already in existing activity_images vocab — reuse those assets. The core concepts students most benefit from communicating are the repeated challenge ('want to fight'), size comparison (big/small), time/clock, and the emotional contrast between grouchy and friendly. Secondary animals (stag beetle, gorilla, skunk, fox, snake, bird) are already in activity_images but were not selected for the 11 fringe slots to avoid overcrowding — the whale and the emotional vocabulary were prioritised as more communicatively generative. Consider adding a visual timer activity alongside this board to reinforce the time theme.
